notes.note: 15 of his 24 were handballs as he led the game with 14 contested possessions. One of just 3 Hawks over 100 this week.

Newcombe had Dunkley with him for much of the night and the result was his lowest in the last three games. He did lead the game in clearances with 11 but his efficiency for his 25 touches was down at 68%.
Newcombe is a gun and he keeps scoring well with his 34 disposals 12 clearances and 21 contested possessions this week as he led all of those categories in the game.
28 for Newcombe at 71%. He was one of 9 Hawks to reach double figures in the game. A good bounce back from last week.
Newcombe had his quietest game since his previous 68 in round 11. He committed 9 clangers from his 19 disposals.
First under 100 in the last four for Newcombe with his 27 disposals coming at just the 59% efficiency. He is still a great player to own and should bounce back.
31 touches and 15 clearances for Newcombe who is not highly owned but is returning some great scores this season.

Newcombe isn't highly owned but he is delivering scores this year as he led the game with 10 clearances and added 17 contested to go with his 31 disposals. Worth a look if you are needing an M7 or M8 and funds are limited.

Newcombe was fantastic with this his equal highest score of the season so far and his best in the last five games. 36 disposals 9 clearances and 18 contested possessions. There wasn't much more he could do.
This makes it four in a row under 100 for Newcombe but they are all still good scores and just missing out. 17 handballs a part of the 25 disposals and he had a game high 7 clearances.
This was Newcombe's lowest score since opening round in the tight game against Adelaide. The impact on his score came from the 61% efficiency despite leading the game with 10 clearances.
Newcombe was well held in the second term but was good after half time with his 24 disposals including 12 contested possessions which was the most for the Hawks.
Newcombe just missed his fifth 100+ score in a row from his 26 disposals. He did attend the equal most centre ball ups for the Hawks with 22. Nothing to be concerned about.
Newcombe's ton run kept going this week thanks to his 28 disposals. He started to get going in that midfield this week as he had the most CBAs for the Hawks
Newcombe continues to be amongst the best for the Hawks. 30 disposals with 20 contested possessions and 12 clearances which led the game in both categories.
Newcombe was best for the Hawks thanks to his 7 tackles and 24 disposals. He has been over 100 four times now and this week was the first time this season he didn't have the most CBAs for the Hawks.
Newcombe was back above 100 with this being his best of the season so far. 28 disposals and a goal to go with a huge 14 clearances.
Newcombe was a little off this week. However he led the Hawks with 14 contested possessions and 6 clearances.
31 disposals for Newcombe as his last couple of games have been more of what we would like. A bye this week before you consider if you want him.
Newcombe was good in the middle for the Hawks with 22 touches. The Hawks had things easy as they dominated the game.
Newcombe led the CBAs for the Hawks with 32 but like many of the Hawks he couldn't convert that into points for us.  Pass for now.
